episodes.synopsis: Five year old Goro practices baseball every day to be like his dad Shigeharu, a pro ballplayer,until he injures his elbow and decides to retire.
episodes.title: Goro's Dream and Daddy's Dream

episodes.synopsis: Goro invites a boy named Toshiya to play catch, reluctant at first, Toshiya comes to love it. Shigeharu vows to make a comeback as a hitter.
episodes.title: Their Friendship

episodes.synopsis: A little league coach is dazzled by Goro's raw talent and teaches him to throw breaking balls. But Shigeharu, fearing injury, won't let him play.
episodes.title: I Hate You, Daddy!

episodes.synopsis: Shigeharu is back on the team as a hitter and, on his best friend and teammate's suggestion, looks to remarry, but he's absent on Goro's birthday.
episodes.title: A Birthday One Day Late

episodes.synopsis: Goro is captivated by Joe Gibson, a major league player now playing in Japan. When Shigeharu homers off of him, Goro is beside himself with delight.
episodes.title: The Man from the Majors

episodes.synopsis: Shigeharu gets beaned by Gibson, but the Blue Oceans go on to win. Goro falls asleep enraptured, but the next day brings anything but joy.
episodes.title: Farewell...

episodes.synopsis: Three years after his father's death, Goro joins the Mifune little league team. The coach welcomes him warmly, but the team has no love for the game.
episodes.title: Goro Honda, Age Nine!

episodes.synopsis: Kaoru Shimizu joins the Mifune team, but they're still two players short. Goro then runs into his classmate Komori, who's being forced to shoplift.
episodes.title: Team Complete!

episodes.synopsis: Komori and Sawamura join the Mifune Dolphins, who now have a full team, but they have to play a game to save the team despite having hardly practiced.
episodes.title: Alone on the Mound

episodes.synopsis: Having learned the importance of teamwork, Goro steps up his game and puts down the adult batters, but his own team can't hit the opposing pitcher.
episodes.title: Showdown in the Rain

episodes.synopsis: The Mifune Dolphins have been reborn. Urged by Coach Ando, Goro goes to observe the top little league team in Japan and runs into his old pal Toshiya.
episodes.title: The Team Dad Played On

episodes.synopsis: Gibson, now back in MLB, invites Goro to see him play in San Francisco. Though put off at first, Goro wants to see top-level baseball, so he accepts.
episodes.title: An Invitation From Gibson

episodes.synopsis: The Mifune Dolphins join a training camp during summer break with all the best teams in Japan. Goro runs afoul of another team's heavy hitter.
episodes.title: Summer! Baseball! Training Camp!

episodes.synopsis: After Mifune loses a practice game to Kuki Little in part because he can't bring himself to pitch inside, Goro asks Yokohama Little for a game.
episodes.title: Reckless Practice Match!

episodes.synopsis: Goro, determined to beat Yokohama Little, helps Sawamura practice pitching. When Coach Ando sees them at it, he realizes he'd given up on his dreams.
episodes.title: The Coach's Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Ryoko, the girl Goro just met, is a pitcher for Yokohama Little. He invites her to play ping-pong, upsetting Shimizu and keeping her up all night.
episodes.title: I Quit!

episodes.synopsis: Before the fall tournament, Mifune practices at the batting cages. There, they run into the Okamura triplets, who play for their first-round opponent.
episodes.title: Tournament Start!

episodes.synopsis: The Okamura triplets score a run off Goro with their strategy, and their ironclad defense grinds down Mifune's will, but Shimizu gives them new life.
episodes.title: Aim for victory!

episodes.synopsis: In round two, Mifune faces Totsuka-Nishi Little, led by ace Kyuta Usami. Goro spots Momoko out with Shigeno and is consumed with dread.
episodes.title: Mother's happiness

episodes.synopsis: Mifune is on the ropes; Goro suddenly gives up a home run, and they can't hit Kyuta's pitch. To make matters worse, Komori sprains his wrist.
episodes.title: Goro's mistake!?

episodes.synopsis: Sawamura's desperation bunt gets him on base, breaks up Kyuta's perfect game, and rattles the ace. Mifune then closes the gap to one run.
episodes.title: This is baseball!

episodes.synopsis: Mifune draws Yokohama Little in the quarters, but Komori's injury is worse than they thought. With the team needing a new catcher, Shimizu volunteers.
episodes.title: The night before the match

episodes.synopsis: Coach Ando throws out his back, so Momoko fills in for him against Yokohama Little. Mifune, overwhelmed by the big stage, commits several errors.
episodes.title: No Intention of Losing!

episodes.synopsis: Toshiya gets Goro to hit into a double play. In the top of the 3rd, as Goro gets shelled again, he uncorks his secret weapon on cleanup hitter Majima.
episodes.title: Chase it! Overcome it!

episodes.synopsis: The game enters extra innings. Yokohama Little saps Goro's energy with bunts and puts Ryoko in to pitch. Goro's teammates worry about how he'll react.
episodes.title: Everyone together

episodes.synopsis: Ryoko and Toshiya defy their coach and pitch to Goro. Ryoko puts all her might into her pitch, and Goro musters his last ounce of strength to swing.
episodes.title: I Won't Say Goodbye
